description: Dead stock: on-hand items with ZERO sales velocity over the window (week/month/quarter, default month) — the same definition as the stock-health dead-stock factor (days-of-supply is null when there is stock on hand but no sales). Returns a value-ranked, paged list; each item carries its available quantity (reserved units excluded: they are already sold) and dead value (those units at the item's cost-layer unit cost). Velocity is tenant-wide per item, so this has no warehouse filter. Read-only.

period.description: Velocity window: week, month, or quarter (default month).

name: find_dead_stock
